Vertical bar chart for the WO-04 verification memo: one linear scale showing measured energy per acceptance batch — P1 6 kWh, P3 14 kWh, P2 40 kWh, P4 67 kWh — bars ordered ascending, each labeled with its tabulated value; gridlines at 20/40/60 kWh; a side panel lists quality margins (+18, +6, +9, +20 against the 80 floor) and spare defect slots (4, 0, 4, 0 against the ceiling of 5), with zero-spare rows visually flagged. Clean sans-serif, navy accent #1F3B5B, white background; every drawn value must match the trusted table exactly; no decorative or non-analytic elements.
